requirements.requirement: Establish BGP with node1 in AS 65100 between node2 in AS 65101 and node3 in AS 65102 over the dedicated peer-a/peer-b links, keeping management outside the transit data plane.
requirements.summary: Both dedicated /31 links are addressed and operational. The expected BGP sessions are established with the correct AS numbers. Management addresses and default routes remain on eth0/enp1s0, while endpoint routes use eth1/eth2 and enp8s0.

requirements.requirement: Give each Ubuntu peer a stable endpoint prefix and have it originate only that prefix.
requirements.summary: node2 has persistent 198.51.100.1/24 endpoint configuration and node3 has persistent 203.0.113.1/24 configuration. Final advertised-route views show exactly one prefix from each peer: its own endpoint prefix.

requirements.requirement: Have node1 learn both endpoint routes and provide each peer with the route to the opposite endpoint.
requirements.summary: node1 learns 198.51.100.0/24 from AS 65101 and 203.0.113.0/24 from AS 65102. It advertises only the opposite endpoint to each peer, and both Ubuntu peers install that route with an AS path through 65100.

requirements.requirement: Provide working bidirectional transit through node1 while preserving endpoint source addresses.
requirements.summary: Source-bound ICMP succeeds in both directions. Captures on both dedicated peer links show requests and replies retaining the original 198.51.100.1 and 203.0.113.1 addresses, directly demonstrating source-preserving transit.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied with direct control-plane, routing-table, connectivity, and packet-capture evidence. BGP transit is operational over the dedicated links, advertisements are restricted to the requested endpoint prefixes, management routing remains separate, and endpoint addresses are preserved end to end.
limitations: No reboot or service-restart transition was captured, so persistence is supported by saved and enabled configuration rather than directly observed post-restart recovery.
Connectivity testing was bounded to short ICMP exchanges rather than sustained traffic or throughput testing.

operational_hygiene.summary: No new failed services or package damage is observed; node1's two failed units existed before execution. Minor hygiene residue remains on node2 and node3 in the form of FRR installation logs/PID files and packet-capture files under /tmp.
